fix.note: Plural/uncountable measure word; after an adjective = 'a bit more': 快啲.

ex.r: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 maan6 di1 aa3
ex.en: Could you speak a bit slower?

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 di1 saang1 gwo2
ex.en: I want to buy some fruit.
Kevin might be stuck in traffic.

ex.r: gam1 maan5 ho2 nang4 wui5 lok6 jyu5
ngo5 ho2 nang4 jiu3 gaa1 baan1
ex.en: I might have to work overtime.

fix.note: Marks the receiver; also 'let'. Also written 畀.

ex.r: m4 goi1 bei2 bui1 seoi2 ngo5
ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6 hai6 bei2 nei5 ge3
gam1 ci3 ngo5 bei2 cin2 haa6 ci3 nei5 ceng2
ex.en: I'll pay this time, you treat next time.

fix.en: to return; go back; (after verb) back
fix.note: 返工 go to work, 返學 go to school, 還返 give back.

ex.en: I go to work at eight.

ex.r: siu2 pang4 jau5 ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 hok6
ex.en: The kids don't have school tomorrow.

ex.r: gei3 dak1 waan4 faan1 bun2 syu1 bei2 ngo5
ex.en: Remember to give my book back.

fix.note: Plural of 呢個; also for uncountables like water or food.

ex.r: ni1 di1 hai6 mat1 je5 lai4 gaa3
ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 ni1 di1
ex.en: I don't like eating this stuff.

notes: Content and Jyutping sound; all 59 dictionary CHECKs are correct colloquial readings (會 wui5, 聽 teng1, 間 gaan1, 平 peng4, 驚 geng1, 個女 neoi2…). Fixed four wrong pos labels and one over-specific translation.
